messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — PR #14222 is ready for final review. Tests are green locally but mac-smoke snapshots failed intermittently in CI. Can someone eyeball? I need a second approver to unblock merge today.
Maria: @Alex linking logs?
Alex: Sure — failing snippet from the CI job:
```
FAIL test_mac_render_snapshots (tests/smoke/test_render.py::TestRender)
AssertionError: Image mismatch for component_header.png
Diff: 12 pixels
```
Alex: It only fails on shard 7 and repros sporadically. Re-running didn't fail locally.
Jordan: I can take a look in ~30m. Is this flaky or a real delta?
Sam: Is this the PR that touched font fallback? If so, might be a tolerances issue.
Maria: If it's intermittent, let's try a targeted rerun on shard 7 first. CI Bot can requeue.
CI Bot: @Alex requested a rerun for job mac-smoke/shard7 — queued (retry 1/3).
Alex: Thx. Also FYI the change gated a minor CSS tweak, not touching rendering logic.
Jordan: On it. If the rerun fails again, can you attach the full artifact link?
Alex: Artifact link: https://ci.internal/reports/14222/mac-shard7/attempt1
Sam: :thinking_face: I see a tiny font rendering offset in the artifact, could be DPI variance.
Jordan: Rerun came back PASS on attempt 1/3. Looks like nondet. I'll give a quick thumbs-up if it stays stable for one more run.
CI Bot: mac-smoke/shard7 rerun result: PASS (attempt 2/3)
Jordan: I'm okay approving given two clean runs and the CSS change scope. @Maria can you also confirm no perf regression?
Maria: Quick perf snapshot shows no regression: p95 latency within 1%. Approving from infra side.
Alex: Thanks everyone! @Jordan please LGTM when you can and I'll merge.
Jordan: LGTM — merging now. :merge:
Alex: Merged and cherry-picked to release branch. Closing.
Sam: Nice, glad it was flaky and not a regression.
CI Bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for main -> staging.
